label: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3200-24GT4XS
description: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3200-24GT4XS - 28-port Layer 2+ managed switch: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and 4x 10GE SFP+ uplinks, no PoE and no module slots. 128 Gbps switching capacity, 95.23 Mpps, one fixed fan, 512 MB RAM / 256 MB flash, 28.028 W maximum draw, 440 x 207.5 x 43.6 mm, 2.9 kg.
notes: Datasheet: "Total number of RJ45 ports 24", "Number of 10GE SFP+ ports 4", "Number of 1GE combo ports No", "Module slots No", "Reset button 1", "Maximum power consumption 28.028 W", "RAM 512 MB", "Flash memory 256 MB", "Fan 1 x fixed fan", "Acoustic noise 25 C: 45 dB", 440 x 207.5 x 43.6 mm, 2.9 kg, "Power supply Fixed power supply", 100-240 V AC input at 1.5 A maximum. Management is web/cloud only: the datasheet lists SSH "No", HTTP login "Yes", HTTPS login "Yes", eWeb, SNMPv1/v2c/v3 and Ruijie Cloud / Reyee App; there is no console port and no serial CLI in the datasheet, so no cli capability and no console interface. Layer 2+ software: "IEEE 802.1Q VLAN Yes", "LACP Yes", "STP/RSTP/MSTP Yes", "DHCP client Yes", "DHCP relay Yes", "DHCP server No", "IPv4 static route Yes", "IPv6 static route Yes" - static routes and relay, no dynamic routing protocol is listed. Port names ge1..geN / sfp1..sfpN / sfp+1..sfp+4 are the catalogue naming convention for a web-managed access switch; the datasheet states port counts, not names. The product page hero block prints "Forwarding Rate 96 Mpps" against the datasheet figure of 95.23 Mpps; the datasheet wins and 95.23 is recorded. The same hero block prints a "PoE Budget 370W / Max. 30W on Each Port" panel on this non-PoE model - the spec table carries no PoE rows at all, so this box cannot source PoE.
